name: battleships
description: A dark naval-radar Battleship made for the PCH-1000 OLED (960×544, 60 FPS).
long_description: A dark naval-radar Battleship made for the PCH-1000 OLED (960×544, 60 FPS). You can play against a Hunt & Target CPU, or against another Vita over Ad-Hoc with no router. Every sound is synthesised in code, so the game needs no audio files.
